title: UXResearch
body1:
You are invited to take part in a research study about how people use an AI chatbot to discover movies and TV shows. The study has three parts: a short questionnaire, a chat with an AI recommendation chatbot, and another short questionnaire at the end. There are no correct or incorrect responses. This study evaluates the chatbot, not the participants.

What we collect. We record your questionnaire answers, the full text of your conversation with the chatbot, and timing information (for example, how long each part takes). We do not ask for your name or contact information. Please do not include personal identifying information in your chat messages or questionnaire answers.

How your data is used. Your responses are used for research purposes only and are analyzed together with the responses of other participants.

Voluntary participation. Taking part is voluntary. You may stop at any time by closing your browser window; responses from sessions that are not completed are not saved.
